rule: Demands guide research design. Registration only — no election ingest, no new panel, no locked voting-age policy.

demands.name: md_municipal_election_record_inventory
demands.question: Which Maryland 16+ municipal adopters publish age/cohort-capable registration and turnout records for before/after and neighbor comparisons?
demands.outcome_note: Coding complete for adopters/controls/Newark warning. Almost no machine_ready age tables; next = clerk canvass requests.

demands.name: youth_registration_and_turnout_bundle
demands.question: Can we measure registration rate, turnout among registered 16–17, turnout among eligible 16–17, 18–24 turnout, and overall turnout for adopter and control municipalities?

demands.name: habit_formation_after_18
demands.question: Do cohorts enfranchised at 16–17 show higher participation after age 18 than comparable cohorts?

demands.name: competition_and_ballot_quality
demands.question: Do candidate competition, uncontested races, and undervotes/ballot exhaustion change around youth enfranchisement?

demands.name: civic_education_and_campaign_contact
demands.question: What school civic-education exposure and campaign contact with young voters accompany each case?

demands.name: local_news_coverage_covariate
demands.question: How does local-news coverage of youth-relevant contests covary with participation and competition?

demands.name: newark_failure_mode_documentation
demands.question: Preserve Newark 2025 school-board youth registration/turnout against overall turnout (~1,851 registered / 73 voted ≈ 3.94% vs ~3.47% overall) as contrary/qualifying evidence — not a hidden exception.

demands.name: brattleboro_ballot_split
demands.question: Can Brattleboro town vs unified school-district ballots be separated so youth eligibility differences become a within-community natural comparison?

demands.name: austria_capability_literature
demands.question: What does peer-reviewed Austrian evidence say about vote-choice quality and motivation of under-18 voters relative to older voters?

demands.name: wales_scotland_repeated_cycles
demands.question: What youth registration/turnout/knowledge/campaign-attention patterns appear across Scotland and Wales (including Senedd 2021 and 2026), without attributing aggregate turnout changes to youth voting alone?

demands.name: institutional_conditions_vs_dcc
demands.question: How do outcomes differ across rights-without-infrastructure vs rights+education vs rights+networks vs rights+meaningful local decisions vs all three (joint with HYP-126)?

demands.name: sequencing_education_vs_enfranchisement
demands.question: Does civic education before enfranchisement outperform, underperform, or interact with enfranchisement-first learning-by-voting?
